episodes.title: Jolly Ranchers
episodes.summary: Ray and Manny decide their fake drug busts could be more lucrative, so they recruit a third partner and target an unassuming country house.

episodes.title: Bat Out of Hell
episodes.summary: Dealing with the repercussions of their robbery gone wrong, Ray and Manny go into hiding while trying to keep their families safe.

episodes.title: Run, Die, or Relapse
episodes.summary: Ray combs the streets looking for Manny as the biker gang closes in. DEA agents search for new leads in their hunt for Ray.

episodes.title: Philadelphia Lawyer
episodes.summary: Ray enlists Son's help with the biker gang. Manny descends deeper into despair. Agents pressure Michelle as a way to get to Ray.

episodes.title: Fear of God
episodes.summary: Manny feels compelled to make amends. Mina digs into Jack's part in the operation. An unexpected person comes to Ray's rescue.

episodes.title: Love Songs from Mars
episodes.summary: Ray refuses to go to the hospital as the situation at Theresa's house unfolds into chaos.

episodes.title: Mussolini
episodes.summary: Agents devise a plan to see if Ray knows more than he's letting on. Sherry gives Manny news.

episodes.title: Innocent People
episodes.summary: Season finale. Ray comes clean and finds an unlikely ally in his search for the truth.
